children: said on Wednesday that its board had approved a new dividend policy.
- Provides for a return of capital to shareholders of up to 20% of annual OIBDA during the 2027–2028 period.
- MTS plans to pay dividends three times a year.
- 70% of the total shareholder return will be allocated to dividend payments.
